+# Mediterranean Dinner Menu (Serves 6)
+
+## Main Course
+*   **Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Skewers**: Tender pieces of chicken marinated in extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, and thyme.
+
+## Sides (All Dairy-Free)
+*   **Classic Hummus & Warm Pita Bread**: Creamy chickpea dip served with soft, toasted pita points. 
+*   **Mediterranean Cucumber-Tomato Salad**: Crisp cucumbers, sweet cherry tomatoes, thinly sliced red onions, and fresh parsley tossed in a light lemon-olive oil vinaigrette. (No cheese)
+*   **Roasted Eggplant & Red Bell Peppers**: Sliced eggplant and bell peppers roasted until tender, seasoned with a sprinkle of za'atar.
+
+## Dessert 
+*   **Fresh Fruit Platter**: A refreshing assortment of grapes, melon, and seasonal fresh figs.
+
+---
+
+# Grocery Shopping List
+
+## Produce
+*   Lemons (4-5)
+*   Garlic (1 head)
+*   Fresh oregano (1 small bunch)
+*   Fresh thyme (1 small bunch)
+*   Fresh flat-leaf parsley (1 bunch)
+*   Cucumbers (2 large English or 4-5 small Persian)
+*   Cherry or grape tomatoes (2 pints)
+*   Red onion (1 large)
+*   Medium eggplants (2)
+*   Red bell peppers (2 large)
+*   Assorted fresh fruit for dessert (e.g., 1 bunch grapes, 1 small melon, 1/2 pint fresh figs)
+
+## Meat
+*   Boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs (approx. 2.5 - 3 lbs) - *Tip: Thighs will stay juicier on the grill.*
+
+## Pantry & Dry Goods
+*   Extra virgin olive oil (1 bottle, ensure you have plenty for marinades and dressings)
+*   Kosher salt or sea salt (Check pantry)
+*   Black peppercorns (Check pantry)
+*   Za'atar seasoning blend (1 small jar)
+*   Pita bread (2 packages / 12 pieces total) - *Check label to confirm dairy-free*
+*   Prepared hummus (1 large 16oz tub or 2 standard tubs) - *Check label, usually dairy-free*
+*   Wooden or metal skewers (If using wooden, remember to soak them in water before grilling)
